text:
maria: Heads up — planning a terraform apply during the quiet window tonight 23:40-00:10 UTC. Target stack: infra/networking/main. There is a KMS rotation + route53 change in the plan.

deploy-bot: deploybot: preflight queued for infra/networking/main at 2965432100. plan id: pb-42. runner: tf-operator-03. Logs: https://deploy.internal/plans/pb-42

samir: Noted. saw another plan from branch feature/tenant-isolate running a plan right now. We should serialise to avoid state lock fights.

aj: Can we pin provider version for this apply? Last time provider bump caused drift. Suggest pinning to `hashicorp/aws` v4.12.0 for this run.

kevin: Also add an early abort rule: if plan shows >30 route table updates or any gateway replacement, we abort and escalate.

maria: Agree on provider pin and abort thresholds. I'll add to the run instructions. If state lock blocked, do NOT force-unlock without explicit approval.

deploy-bot: preflight check: plan completed. Summary: +6 resources, -1, ~2 replacements. Contains: aws_kms_key.rotate, aws_route53_record.update, aws_route_table.assoc(4 updates). Full diff: https://deploy.internal/plans/pb-42/diff

samir: The other plan (pb-41) shows `Error: remote state is locked` and is stuck at apply step. @maria we should wait for pb-41 owner to release or coordinate takeover.

ops-bot: ops playbook reminder: to take over a stuck plan, get explicit approval from state-owner and infra-oncall, then run:

```
terraform force-unlock LOCK_ID
terraform apply -auto-approve
```

Only use `force-unlock` if plan owner is unreachable. Document the LOCK_ID and the reason in the ticket.

aj: I'm pinging @kevin (owner of pb-41) to confirm whether they can finish or want us to takeover.

kevin: I'm on it — had to step away. I can finish apply in ~8m. If you need to run, wait for my OK.

maria: OK we'll gate pb-42 until pb-41 completes. Change window extended by +10m. If pb-41 fails or shows >threshold replacements, we abort both and roll back to previous module version.

deploy-bot: live update: pb-41 completed apply successfully at 2965432160. No replacements, 3 small updates.

samir: Great. We can proceed with pb-42. Reminder: pin provider and set TF_VAR_confirm_changes=false to avoid accidental interactive confirms.

maria: Proceeding to apply in 30s. Oncall: @aj (watch logs), @samir (routing verify), @kevin (KMS key sanity). Standby pager.

deploy-bot: running `terraform apply -auto-approve -lock=true` (pb-42) — streaming logs: https://deploy.internal/runs/rn-9001

deploy-bot: apply step: aws_route_table.assoc[2] replacement in progress...

kevin: seeing KMS key rotation in progress. Confirming CMKs retained per compliance.

aj: routing check: 20% traffic shifted to AZ-a (canary) as planned. No errors in metrics.

maria: if any gateway replacement pops up we abort.

deploy-bot: apply completed at 2965432215. Result: success. Outputs: route53 record updated, kms rotation triggered.

samir: Verified route tables and propagation looks clean. No 5xx spikes.

maria: Closing change window. Recording postmortem notes in the release ticket: pinned provider, enforced abort threshold, serialized plans. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
